scope: First beta cutover to KMS-only passport custody and KMS-verified bureau callbacks after application writers stop
missing_job_table: allow initial deployment before native physical-document migration
writer_fence: Hold one exclusive beta deployment/restore mutation lock from before the application inventory and backup through maintenance, drain, migration, and application restart. Persist a host-wide pending marker before stopping writers; an interrupted mutation blocks a new deployment until a supervised restore succeeds. After stopping writers, re-enumerate every beta application and infrastructure writer plus the UI and reject any running replacement before querying the drain or claiming a quiesced backup. Clear the pending marker after successful deployment or restore, or after a pre-mutation failure only when the exact prior running container set has been verified restored.
policy: Every nonterminal physical-document job blocks callback cutover, including a SOD_SIGNED job whose bureau_job_id is still null during bureau submission. A stored legacy Fernet or unknown artifact blocks even if its job is terminal, because this cutover has no artifact migration or replay path.

artifact_policy.native_shape: JSON object with schema marty.passport-artifact-manifest/v1 and one or more bounded vault:v ciphertext chunks
artifact_policy.legacy_or_unknown: block regardless of job status; keep ciphertext inside the database query and return only counts without logging parser details
artifact_policy.malformed_native_manifest: block or fail closed on query error
artifact_policy.first_cutover: zero rows is sufficient and expected before native issuance; later native-only rows may remain

flow_policy.selector: physical_document_issuance definition, custom definition extending physical_document_issuance, or context carrying physical_document_job; block nonterminal orphan instances unless they meet the exact expired synthetic OID4VP verification exemption
flow_policy.active: block even when no physical-document job exists yet; a paused Flow may create or resume a job after cutover
flow_policy.expired_orphan_verification_exemption: A definitionless awaiting_wallet instance may be excluded only when expiry is past, no current step or application flow key exists, step history is empty, context identifies the synthetic __verification__ OID4VP presentation flow with nonempty JSON strings auth_request, oid4vp_profile, and request_uri, neither physical_document nor passport appears in context, and its provenance is either holder with verification_started by verification_api or legacy applicant with empty state history. Null, object, and empty-string markers do not qualify. All other definitionless nonterminal instances block. Preserve exempted rows without mutation.
flow_policy.missing_schema_or_query_failure: fail closed; do not infer zero active flows
